name: miaocast-promo
description: MiaoCast multilingual promo film (zh-CN / en / ja, no narration) built with Remotion

scripts.render:zh: remotion render src/index.tsx MiaoCastPromo out/miaocast-promo-zh.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:en: remotion render src/index.tsx MiaoCastPromoEn out/miaocast-promo-en.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:ja: remotion render src/index.tsx MiaoCastPromoJa out/miaocast-promo-ja.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:all: npm run render:zh && npm run render:en && npm run render:ja
